import sqlite3
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB_PATH = 'reservations.db'

@tool
def cancel_reservation_record(reservation_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute('DELETE FROM reservations WHERE id = ?', (reservation_id,))
        conn.commit()
        deleted = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = {'reservation_id': reservation_id, 'cancelled': deleted > 0}
    if not deleted:
        result['error'] = 'Reservation not found'
    else:
        # Run the waitlist refresh script so freed tables can be reassigned
        proc = subprocess.run(['./scripts/refresh_waitlist.sh', reservation_id], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        result['waitlist_refresh_exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    return result
